headline: Dictate your complaint — the FEEDBACK button grew a microphone
lede: Reports from a phone mid-game no longer need typing: both the in-game feedback panel and every demo's credits card take dictation, appending spoken phrases to your note while a live line shows what the mic heard. Part of #737's one-motion playing-and-QA.

notes.text: FEEDBACKDICT merged (dfe918c): DICTATE toggle in the in-game panel and all 13 demo cards — finals append cleanly, interims flicker live, the button hides itself where no recognizer exists, and closing the panel always silences the mic.
feedbackcheck grew 16 gates to 175/175 GREEN — the recognizer pipeline is driven by a fake SpeechRecognition in plain Node (no mic, no browser), and a removed stop() handler turns it RED and back.
#737's forge legs are done; what remains is Jon's bar: three mid-game phone reports, then a 30-second QA replay — Gauntlet/QBert/Tetris/PickRush replay reported seeds exactly.
Studio-wide: slot b shipped seedpin batch 1 (#1474) — 8 more titles now report and honor ?seed=N under the #1473 rollout.
